SYNTHETIC LAB & DESIGN
Sovereign Federation Lab / Reader guide · edition 09

Authenticate the entity. Resolve the store.

Business API access needs both legal-entity context and a permitted physical processing location.

Proposed pilot design

This page describes a target design. The local lab and browser models demonstrate bounded subsets; the proposal is not production acceptance. Understand the labels.

Start with the example · Look up a term

Select the service, then enforce its permissions

Proposed pilot design. A gateway or existing service adapter consumes trusted placement decisions from the sovereignty layer. Writes target the current owner; reads can use an authorised recipient view with suitable freshness. Business services continue to execute their APIs and rules. The handler revalidates authority and permissions; a cached route never makes an old writer valid after cutover.

The loopback lab gateway proxies one harness. It does not implement distributed read/write routing. Follow the routing explanation.

Request path

01Regional gateway

Verify user/service identity, legal-entity scope and operation.

02Entity-aware routing

Resolve owner binding from a verified directory revision.

03Placement and access gate

Check requested processing geography before forwarding payload.

04Regional service

Reauthorize business access and perform the local owner transaction.

Endpoint contracts

EndpointResponsibility
Regional business gatewayOIDC/OAuth, request limits, entity scopes, approved routing and in-region TLS termination.
Regional serviceNever trust a caller-supplied entity header alone; derive permitted context from identity and policy.
Federation ingressSeparate private listener; mTLS workload identity and destination-entity/store-bound permit.
Regional admin BFFEntity/operator-scoped views and policy changes, not unrestricted global customer inspection.
Local PoC gatewayFastAPI :8000 hosts admin, business-read and worker controls. No authentication; synthetic local use only.

Entity and location are different checks

A user entitled to LE-GB-02 does not automatically have permission to process an excluded customer in the US. Store placement controls do not by themselves govern operator workstations, ingress termination or remote support. The production policy contract must include requesting processing country, identity, purpose and operation; those access-location controls are extension work beyond this PoC.

Failure behaviour

The PoC remote business read rechecks current owner policy and requires the projection’s current generation and placement version. It does not use offline leases. Owner or OPA unavailability fails the operation; there is no nearest-region fallback or automatic write promotion.

Entity relocation decision: keep legal entity identity stable while changing physical home. Use a lawful transition policy, snapshot plus continuous change capture, versioned tombstones, target-applied checkpoints, graph closure and an entity-specific source writer fence. Persist source fencing before activating the target; never flip routing back after target writes. Separate placement version, writer epoch, policy revision and resource data version. Migration consumes the capped bulk lane; guard and operational capacity remain reserved. The executable edition-08 slice uses isolated mig_* row envelopes and one coordinator; it does not migrate the original normalized business.* fixture or prove distributed fencing. Read Entity relocation before implementation.

Extend the v3 operational PoC, preserving 30 legal entities and three independent single-node store models. Business data is normalized across 12 tables; sovereignty policies live in parallel control tables. A separate party scope exports only id/global_party_id/party_type; relationship scopes export connected whitelisted graphs. Global distribution still needs grants and approved geography; deny overrides. Do not infer relationship access from a global party, common store or shared identity. Keep the single local transaction and asynchronous destination acknowledgement distinct. The hosted UI is a labelled browser simulation. The unified Docker/CockroachDB/OPA suite and live Chromium generator/migration walkthrough passed. Database crash boundaries, accessibility and pilot load remain separate gates. Use synthetic data only. Deliver bounded adapters, actual migrations, meaningful invariant tests and honest run results.

Apply the normalized operational extension before the earlier component requirements below.

Extract the harness into regional business services behind gateways. Verify legal-entity scopes from authenticated identity, resolve versioned bindings, and reject prohibited processing locations before routing payload. Add mTLS exporter/importer identity. Test spoofed entity headers, shared-store lateral reads and an allowed entity accessed through an excluded country.
